name: anti-slop
tagline: Opinionated Oxlint rules that reject low-evidence AI slop
description: anti-slop is a set of opinionated Oxlint rules that reject low-evidence TypeScript and JavaScript patterns commonly produced by AI assistants. It is part of the wider anti-AI-slop movement, giving teams a linting layer that catches weak, hand-wavy code before it ships. It comes from dmmulroy, a popular neovim plugin author, so expect a sharp, opinionated take on what counts as solid code.
highlights: Opinionated Oxlint rules targeting low-evidence TS/JS patterns
A linting-layer answer to the anti-AI-slop movement
Catches weak, hand-wavy AI output before it ships
From dmmulroy, a well-known neovim plugin author
curatorNote: As AI-generated code floods repos, anti-slop gives teams a linting layer to push back. Backed by a respected neovim plugin author, this is one of the more credible entries in the anti-slop space.
